title: Challenges in India's Transport Infrastructure Development
subject: Geography
description: A mindmap illustrating the major challenges faced in the development of highways and waterways in India, including land acquisition, environmental concerns, funding, and seasonal variability.
mermaidCode:
mindmap
root((Challenges in Transport Infrastructure Development))
  Land Acquisition
    Urban sprawl
    Agricultural pressures
    Project delays (e.g., Delhi-Mumbai Expressway)
  Environmental Concerns
    Dredging (e.g., Brahmaputra basin)
    Habitat disruption objections
  Funding Gaps
    Central government earmarks (e.g., Bharatmala)
    Uneven state contributions
    Affects SH upgrades
  Seasonal Variability
    Monsoon-induced flooding
    Limits year-round navigation on NWs
    Necessitates flood-management infrastructure
